scripts.format: biome format --write . && uv run ruff format scripts tests
scripts.format:check: biome format . && uv run ruff format --check scripts tests
scripts.lint: biome lint . && uv run ruff check scripts tests
scripts.test:python: uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.prepare:study: uv run python scripts/build_full_decks.py && uv run python scripts/verify_full_library.py
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build --config app/vite.config.ts && npm run build:server
